title: Golang UK Conf. 2016 - Liz Rice - What is a container, really? Let's write one in Go from scratch
summary: Liz Rice builds a container from scratch in about 100 lines of Go, showing that a container is not a lightweight VM but a set of Linux kernel features and flags.
why: HN recommends it as an accessible way to remove the magic from Docker and understand how containers work.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: have given talks on how to make containers from scratch that are very illuminating
